selection_rationale: All ships can do 3g. Three torpedo boats carry 24 rounds between them, enough to fire coordinated salvos that can saturate a capital's point defence. The frigate escorts them with 2 extra PD turrets. Every hull is fast, so we can choose the range, fire from beyond the zone where enemy guns get accurate, and pull away from slow capitals.
formation_rationale: The cheap frigate Ward goes 40 km ahead in the center. It takes the first exchange and soaks enemy fire and torpedoes before they reach the corvettes. The three Darts form a triangle behind it, spread up to 45 km sideways and 15–30 km vertically. That spread makes enemy spinal weapons harder to line up, and every ship stays within about 100 km of the others so their point defense overlaps against torpedoes. Dart-3 sits a little further back in reserve to follow up or cover a flank.
